zh: 專案按計畫進行，進度符合時程，預計如期交付。
專案進度落後，交付日期延後，無法依原定時程完成。
專案遭遇阻礙，工作卡關，需要先排除問題才能繼續。
專案已取消，不再繼續執行，也不會交付原定成果。
en: The project is on track and progressing as planned. Delivery is expected on schedule.
The project is delayed and behind schedule. Delivery will miss the original deadline.
The project is blocked by an unresolved dependency. Work cannot proceed until it is resolved.
The project has been cancelled. Work will not resume and the planned deliverable will not be shipped.
